next_step: Complete POC acceptance criteria and security sign-off; schedule CISO review week of 2026-03-22
notes:
POC focus: Private VPC deployment in customer AWS account (eu-west-1). Goal: validate end-to-end deployability, KMS integration, audit logging, and performance SLOs before procurement.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE+SE) with Eng + Infra leads. AE to send high-level architecture. Action: Ethan to share private deployment checklist.
- 2026-02-05: Security kickoff with CISO proxy + infra. Discussed KMS envelope encryption, audit sinks, data residency. Fireflies: FF-20260302-01 (detailed notes in drive).
- 2026-02-18: Network and identity deep-dive. Confirmed Okta SSO, need SAML metadata exchange and RBAC mapping. Customer: requires IdP-initiated and SP-initiated.
- 2026-02-25: Terraform/Helm plan review. SE proposed using redwood-terraform-modules + helm chart to deploy control plane in customer VPC (EKS + managed node groups or self-hosted GPUs). Customer prefers Aurora for DB and EFS for cache persistence.
- 2026-03-02: POC kickoff call. Agreed milestone dates and acceptance criteria. Created Jira INF-5441 for deployment automation issues.

POC scope / tech details:
- Deploy Redwood Private control plane in customer VPC via our Terraform modules and Helm charts. Repo: (internal) redwood/terraform-modules/private-vpc-template.
- Identity: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM optional for user sync.
- Crypto: Integrate with customer AWS KMS CMK (customer-managed). Support envelope encryption; request for HSM-backed key (KMS key origin AWS_CLOUDHSM) flagged for CISO.
- Logging & Audit: Push control plane audit logs to customer's Splunk index via Kinesis Firehose; application-level request logs to Datadog. Retention policy: initial 3 years, legal asking about 7-year retention—legal to confirm.
- Networking: VPC peering or Transit Gateway. Private endpoints only, no public ingress. Customer requires strict IP allowlist and bastion jump host for admin.
- Deployment artifacts: Terraform plan + state backend (customer-managed S3 + DynamoDB for locking), Helm chart values for each component, sample k8s manifests for GPU nodes.
- Integration testing: run-zero smoke tests, token-level cost measurement, latency/throughput test harness (k6 + custom token generator), end-to-end regression with customer prompt set.

Acceptance criteria (explicit):
- Functional: end-to-end inference (chat) with sample app in customer's VPC.
- Security: SSO working, audit events observed in Splunk, KMS envelope encryption verified for model cache and logs.
- Performance: sustained 300 QPS with 95th latency <120ms for 512-token context; 99th <250ms for chat with 2k token context during peak synthetic load.
- Reliability: automatic fallback policy validated (route to dedicated node pool) and can tolerate node termination without >1% request error.
- Cost target: per-token unit cost within 15% of hosted baseline (customer KPI).
- Documentation: delivery of runbook + terraform/helm templates + security attestation.

Open questions / risks:
- HSM/KMS: customer wants explicit HSM-backed key; need design review with Redwood infra (SE: Priya). Action: confirm compatibility and guidance for BYOK.
- Network: transit gateway vs peering decision delayed by networking team; peering approval timeline impacts POC start.
- Log retention compliance for financial audit (7 years) — legal needs confirmation.
- On-prem GPU nodes: customer may require burst to on-prem during peak; product currently supports private with cloud-first approach.

Recent action items (owners):
- Priya Nair: produce Terraform plan draft and helm values (due 2026-03-15).
- Ethan Brooks: coordinate legal DPA and CISO meeting (due 2026-03-18).
- Customer infra lead (Thomas Leclerc): provision peering CIDR and S3 bucket for tfstate (due 2026-03-12, delayed).
- Security (Lucas Meyer): provide SOC2/ISO artifacts and mapping doc for audit logging (due 2026-03-16).

Next steps (short):
- Resolve network peering by 2026-03-18.
- Run first automated deploy (terraform apply) in staging VPC under customer account once peering + tfstate are ready.
- After staging deploy: run integration test suite, execute perf run with customer traffic profile, produce POC report and sign-off checklist.

POC sign-off criteria: Security attestation + performance checklist + operations runbook accepted by customer security and platform teams. If signed, move to contract negotiation for dedicated capacity + 12mo support agreement.

CRM style notes/quotes:
- "Need to see actual keys in our KMS and the audit trail before legal will greenlight." — CISO proxy.
- "If latency stays under 200ms for typical chat, we can justify migration of 3 core services." — Head of ML.
- "We want Terraform/Helm — not one-off scripts. Our infra team needs idempotent deployments." — Infra lead.

Attachment stubs: drive://security-assessment/latitudes-shield/poc-plan.md, drive://artifacts/latitudes-shield/okta-metadata.xml, INF-5441 for infra blockers.

Status summary: active POC in progress; main blockers: network peering + legal DPA; KMS-HSM question escalated to infra/security. SE and AE aligned on timeline to aim for procurement decision 2026-06 if POC passes.
